name: Fabio Cannavaro
years: born 1973; Ballon d'Or 2006; Italy career to 2010, retired from playing 2011; coach since 2013; Uzbekistan coach since Oct 2025
recent_news_summary_note: 13 dated stories fall inside the last 90 days (22 Aug - 20 Nov 2026); 2 older stories are included only as context and flagged within_90_days:false. No new club job was found.

recent_news.headline: Uzbekistan beat Iran 3-1 in Fergana, Cannavaro's first match since the World Cup
facts: Eldor Shomurodov scored twice (10' and a 58' penalty); Husayn Norchayev added a stoppage-time third (90+4' per Wikipedia).
Iran equalised at 49': kun.uz calls it a free kick; Wikipedia's results table lists it as an own goal (Urozov), so keep it vague ('Iran pulled one back').
It was the first match for Cannavaro's side since the World Cup (Fergana, Istiqlol Stadium).
recent_news.note: Opponent is Iran: football only, no geopolitical jokes. Removed unverified items from the first draft (Cannavaro blaming a foul near the box and 'only three days to prepare', and the goalkeeper-injury mention): none appear in the cited kun.uz match report.

recent_news.headline: Cannavaro: past service will not guarantee a call-up to Uzbekistan
facts: He said earlier service will no longer earn a place; the squad will be built from players who merit selection and are ready to play ('That will not happen anymore').
He told the team 'whether we win or lose, we have to do it together'.
He said the team has about a month of preparation and expects players to arrive at the next camp in good physical shape; next games were Syria (1 Oct, Tashkent) and South Korea (6 Oct, away).

recent_news.headline: Uzbekistan thrash Syria 4-1 in Tashkent
facts: Goals: Esanov 27', Mozgovoy 45', Norchayev 48' and 90' (Wikipedia results table, Pakhtakor Stadium).
Cannavaro rotated the squad ('I don't have a concept of starting players or substitutes') and said 'step by step we are building a good team'.
He told the group there is no such thing as a friendly match.
Syria's only goal was a late own goal by an Uzbek defender (Khakimov, 90+2').
recent_news.note: Corrected: own goal minute is 90+2' (not 90+3'); removed the unverified claim that Shomurodov started on the bench.

recent_news.headline: South Korea 2-0 Uzbekistan: Cannavaro praises his team's performance despite the defeat
facts: Son Heung-min scored an early free kick (his 59th international goal, a Korean record) and Oh Se-hoon added a header, at Yongin Mireu Stadium.
Cannavaro said his team played a very good game, created many chances and credited Korean goalkeeper Cho Hyeon-woo for the saves; he blamed small mistakes against a strong team.
FIFA ranking before the game: Korea 32nd, Uzbekistan 60th.

recent_news.headline: Reports: Cannavaro signs with a Latin American agency to look for Liga MX or MLS work
facts: Fox Sports Mexico (20 Oct, TUDN report) said his representation agency in Latin America is exploring Liga MX or MLS work; a Liga MX job would depend on a club showing interest and presenting a project.
The same article says no agreement with any club has been confirmed.
Text read via the Plano Informativo republication of the Fox Sports article; the foxsports.com.mx URL did not resolve in this session.
recent_news.note: Rumour/reported item. Phrase as 'reportedly'. The 'separate report' about no agreement in the first draft was the same Fox Sports article republished, not independent.

recent_news.headline: AFC moves the 2027 Asian Cup to 23 Dec 2027 - 21 Jan 2028
facts: The AFC cited 'exceptional circumstances' in the region, including travel disruption; dates still need FIFA approval.
Uzbekistan are in Group B with Jordan, Bahrain and North Korea; January 2027 group games had been planned.
The delay left Cannavaro's future with Uzbekistan under discussion in the press.
recent_news.note: Regional security/war context. Report as a schedule fact only; no jokes.

recent_news.headline: UFA review meeting: Cannavaro tells youth coaches to 'drastically improve' individual skills
facts: Meeting covered 2026 results and 2027 aims: U-17 Asian Cup in May 2027 and the U-20 World Cup in Uzbekistan in Sept-Oct 2027.
Cannavaro urged work on striker and goalkeeper skills, fitness, tactics and mental stability.
Coaches of all seven youth teams (U-14 to U-23) attended.

recent_news.headline: Cannavaro on Sky Italia: 'My dream is to coach Italy'; compares the national job to a Neapolitan coffee
facts: He called coaching in Italy and the national team his goal and said it is a normal ambition (Football Italia, quoting Sky Sport Italia 'Calcio Unplugged').
He described national-team work as short (about 10 days), demanding and stimulating, like a Neapolitan coffee.
He said he enjoys Uzbekistan, has already met 'the president', and wants to return to Italy rather than travel the world or move to Asia.

recent_news.headline: Cannavaro: would talk to UFA before any Serie A offer; says Juve lost its 'you just have to win' identity
facts: Asked what he would do with an official Serie A offer, he said he would discuss it with the Uzbek federation and not decide alone.
UFA press service reportedly denied rumours that he would leave after the Asian Cup was moved.
Tuttosport reported he said Juventus's identity ('Devi solo vincere') has been lost.

recent_news.headline: Pre-Russia press conference: contract runs to autumn 2027, 'relations are good', South America links 'just rumours'
facts: He said every Italian wants to coach Italy and called South American national-team reports rumours.
Masharipov, Urunov, Sergeyev and Yusupov were not in camp; he said there is no conflict with them.
Plan: January camp without foreign-based players, then camps in March, June and September.

recent_news.headline: Uzbekistan blow a 2-0 lead and lose 3-2 to Russia in Tashkent
facts: Russia's own goal (Melyokhin, 5') and Behruz Karimov (46') made it 2-0.
Russia then scored three in nine minutes (Komlichenko 70' and 75', Aleksey Miranchuk 79').
Cannavaro said the defeat hurt morale (Zamin, 18 Nov).
recent_news.note: Roast the collapse only. No jokes about Russia as a country, war or sanctions. Daryo page returned 403, but the scorers and minutes are confirmed by Wikipedia's Uzbekistan results table and the 2-0 lead and 2-3 score by Zamin.

recent_news.headline: Saudi Arabia 1-2 Uzbekistan in Doha: Esanov double ends the slump
facts: Sherzod Esanov scored at 19' and 35'; Firas Al-Buraikan equalised at 23' (Jassim bin Hamad Stadium, Doha).
Saudi defender Ali Lajami was sent off at 50'; Uzbekistan slowed down afterwards.
Live FIFA ranking: 59th, +5.35 points (1418.10 points).
recent_news.note: Second source (Vavel) agrees on score, Al-Buraikan 23' and the red card (its own timeline shows Esanov's second goal at both 33' and 35'; Wikipedia says 35'). Date: Zamin and Wikipedia's results list say 17 Nov; a Wikipedia table caption mentions 16 Nov.

recent_news.headline: Cannavaro: sometimes he prefers equal or fewer men because players show more spirit; 'defenders must stop losing the ball in simple situations'
facts: He said the team slowed after the red card and he has seen that before; he said he would sometimes rather play equal or even a man down because players then show more character and spirit, while an advantage can breed complacency.
He said national-team camps are short, so each session must be used well and individual errors are harder to fix than at a club.
He asked defenders to stop losing the ball in simple situations and wingers to dribble one-on-one without hesitation.

recent_news.headline: First post-World Cup press conference: 'Probably I am the only foolish coach in the world'
facts: He denied flying straight home after the tournament and called a EUR 4m salary report false; he said he pays his assistants himself under an agreement with the federation.
He said he would pick younger players, not reward past contributions, and that someone in the squad leaked false information to the press.
The 'foolish coach' line was said while defending his decision to take an unfit player to the World Cup.
recent_news.note: OLDER than 90 days (about 107 days). Included because it explains the current squad policy. The quote touches a player's health: use the quote as self-deprecation only.

recent_news.headline: After 0-5 loss to Portugal, Cannavaro tells Ronaldo to keep playing a few more years
facts: Ronaldo scored twice (6', 39'); Portugal won 5-0 in Houston and Ronaldo became the first man to score in six World Cups.
Cannavaro said he warned his players that giving Ronaldo a centimetre would be fatal, and told him not to retire.
He joked that Ronaldo is a goal magnet.
recent_news.note: OLDER than 90 days. Classic story that frames the current job.

now.role: Head coach of the Uzbekistan national team (appointed 6 Oct 2025, replacing Timur Kapadze, who stayed as an assistant and resigned on 10 Nov 2025).
now.contract: Runs to October 2027 (he says 'autumn 2027'); the Asian Cup postponement means the federation will discuss it.
now.world_cup_2026: Led Uzbekistan at their first World Cup: lost 1-3 to Colombia, 0-5 to Portugal and 1-3 to DR Congo, finished last in Group K with 0 points, 2 goals scored and 11 conceded.
now.since_world_cup: Five friendlies: W 3-1 Iran, W 4-1 Syria, L 0-2 South Korea, L 2-3 Russia (after leading 2-0), W 2-1 Saudi Arabia. That is 3 wins and 2 losses, 11 goals for and 8 against.
now.ranking: Live FIFA ranking 59th after the Saudi win (60th before the Korea match).
now.next: 2027 Asian Cup now 23 Dec 2027 - 21 Jan 2028 in Saudi Arabia; Group B with Jordan, Bahrain, North Korea. Plans: January camp without foreign-based players, camps in March, June, September 2027.
now.what_people_say: He says his dream is to coach Italy and the Italian national team, and that he would talk to the Uzbek federation before any Serie A offer. Rumours link him to Liga MX/MLS via an agency; the federation denied he would leave.
now.team_trend: Youth refresh after the World Cup; 'no one gets a place for past service' (the World Cup 'bonus' is over).
now.gaps: No November 2026 club appointment found. Wikipedia's managerial table currently lists his Uzbekistan record as 16 matches (6W 2D 8L); that is consistent with the nine 2026 matches counted here (3W 6L) plus seven earlier ones, but it was not independently confirmed.

quick_context: Fabio Cannavaro captained Italy to the 2006 World Cup, playing all 690 minutes without a card while Italy conceded only two goals in the tournament.
He won the 2006 Ballon d'Or and the FIFA World Player award, becoming only the third defender to win the Ballon d'Or after Franz Beckenbauer and Matthias Sammer.
He won 136 caps for Italy and two La Liga titles with Real Madrid (2006-07 and 2007-08).

roast_past.angle: 136 caps for Italy and only 2 goals, in 2004 against Tunisia and in 2008 against Portugal.
The 2004-05 and 2005-06 Juventus titles were later revoked, and he left for Real Madrid as Juventus were sent down. Joke about the timing only, never about wrongdoing.
Coaching CV: Benevento 17 games (3W 7D 7L) and sacked; Dinamo Zagreb 14 games and sacked; Udinese 6 games and not kept; China national team 2 games, 2 defeats.
Gattuso teased him with a hair-gel jibe in late 2025 and Cannavaro said he took it as a joke.
He told Ronaldo to keep playing a few more years, right after Ronaldo scored twice against him.
Italy captain turned world traveller: Al Ahli, Guangzhou, Al Nassr, Tianjin, China national team, Benevento, Udinese, Zagreb, Uzbekistan.
Great defender, famous for the 2006 wall of five clean sheets; his Uzbek World Cup team conceded 11 in three games.

roast_now.angle: Led 2-0 against Russia on 12 Nov and lost 3-2 after three goals in about ten minutes. Roast the collapse only.
'There is no such thing as a friendly' (1 Oct) and then the next two friendlies are lost: South Korea 0-2 and Russia 2-3 (a 2-0 lead thrown away); only then a 2-1 win in Doha.
Dream job: Italy national team, while his contract runs to October 2027 and he says he must discuss any Serie A offer with Uzbekistan first.
On 6 Nov he said he is not chasing jobs abroad; on 20 Oct an agency report said he is shopping for Liga MX or MLS work. Say 'reportedly'.
National-team coaching is 'like a Neapolitan coffee': ten quick days. His own team needed ten minutes to turn 2-0 into 2-3.
After the Saudi red card his team slowed down, and he said he sometimes prefers equal numbers or even fewer men because players show more spirit.
Said defenders must stop losing the ball in simple situations; he is a defender legend, so the squad hears that from the best.
Called himself 'probably the only foolish coach in the world' (Aug). Self-roast only; do not mention the health detail.

praise.angle: 2006 World Cup: all 690 minutes, no cards, 5 clean sheets and 2 goals conceded in the whole tournament.
Only the third defender to win the Ballon d'Or, after Beckenbauer and Sammer.
136 caps for Italy and captain from 2002 to 2010; Italy's most-capped defender.
Won the Chinese Super League in 2019 with Guangzhou Evergrande and League One in 2016 with Tianjin Quanjian.
Since the World Cup: 3 wins in 5 friendlies, 3-1 over Iran, 4-1 over Syria and a 2-1 win in Doha, and Uzbekistan climbed to 59th in the live FIFA ranking.
Under him Uzbekistan scored their first-ever World Cup goal (Fayzullaev, 60') and he promised a youth refresh for the Asian Cup.
